name: word_art
title: Word Art
description: A 2v2 cooperative-vs-competitive game. Each round a secret word is shown to one artist per team; that artist draws ASCII art and passes it to their teammate, who has up to max_attempts guesses. Point value awarded on a correct guess is looked up in guess_points by attempt index (element 0 = attempt 1, element 1 = attempt 2, ...); failing all attempts scores 0. After N rounds the higher total wins. The artist and guesser within each team swap every round.

num_rounds.description: Number of rounds in the episode. Each round draws one word; both teams play in parallel.

max_attempts.description: Number of guesses the guesser gets per artwork. The round ends for a team once they answer correctly or exhaust all attempts.

guess_points.description: Per-attempt point values awarded on a correct guess: element 0 is attempt 1's reward, element 1 is attempt 2's reward, etc. Length must equal max_attempts (mismatch raises at episode init). Values may be fractional (e.g. [2, 1.5, 1]); the reward channel is numeric to accommodate this. Empty (default) is interpreted as [1] * max_attempts (uniform 1 pt per attempt).

include_art_history.description: If true, past rounds' ASCII art bodies are included in the harness prompt's history block. If false, the history block omits the raw art for every past round but still shows the target word, per-team guesses, points, and any disqualification annotation.

max_art_chars.description: Maximum length (in characters) of an artist's ASCII art submission. Longer art is truncated.

actTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds for agent actions. Matches the core harness LLM_CALL_TIMEOUT budget of 3600s, which spans all transport retries of a single call. Anything lower lets the framework kill a seat that the harness still considers in-flight, and since word_art ends the episode on a timed-out seat that would abort otherwise-healthy games. Reasoning-heavy artists were already exceeding 140s at the old 60s default.

seed.description: Seed for random word sampling. Set to null for nondeterministic play.

word_mix.description: Optional per-tier round mix. Keys are tier names ('easy', 'hard'); values are integer counts of rounds to draw from each tier. Counts must sum to num_rounds; a mismatch (or a tier count exceeding its pool size) raises at episode init. Empty (default) samples uniformly at random from the full word pool regardless of tier.

freeForm.description: If true, the core harness allows free-form actions on turns where the action space is not enumerable (artist drawing, guesser typing). Always true for word_art.

illegalMoveForfeit.description: If true, an agent that fails to produce a parseable submission after all harness retries forfeits that single turn (empty art / empty guess) instead of raising, which would abort the whole episode. Word Art alternates roles every round, so an aborted agent would cripple its team for every remaining round -- a single unparseable response should cost one turn, not the match.

savePrompt.description: If disabled, skip logging LLM prompts in the replay file.

saveResponse.description: If disabled, skip logging raw LLM responses in the replay file.

num_rounds.description: Total number of rounds in this episode.

max_attempts.description: Total guesses allowed per artwork (same value all episode; mirrors configuration.max_attempts).

guess_points.description: Per-attempt point values (mirrors configuration.guess_points). Length equals max_attempts; element i is the reward for scoring on attempt i+1. Surfaced on every seat's observation so the harness can quote the scoring table in prompts.

include_art_history.description: Mirrors configuration.include_art_history. Surfaced on every seat's observation so the harness can decide whether to include past art bodies in the history block.

max_art_chars.description: Maximum length (in characters) of an artist's ASCII art submission; longer art is truncated (mirrors configuration.max_art_chars).

phase.description: Current phase of the round: 'art' (artists drawing) or 'guess' (guessers guessing). Empty string before initialization.

role.description: This agent's role in the current round: 'artist' or 'guesser'.

target_word.description: The word to draw, shown ONLY to the artist for this round. Empty string for guessers.

teammate_art.description: ASCII art from this agent's teammate (the artist), shown ONLY to the guesser in the guess phase. Empty string otherwise.

previous_guesses.description: On a guesser's observation during the guess phase: the list of this team's prior incorrect guesses for the current artwork (so the agent knows what NOT to guess again). Empty list otherwise.

attempts_remaining.description: On a guesser's observation during the guess phase: how many guesses this team has left for the current artwork (between 1 and max_attempts). 0 outside the guess phase.

blue_score.description: Total points scored by team Blue so far. Numeric rather than integer because guess_points may contain fractional values.

yellow_score.description: Total points scored by team Yellow so far. Numeric rather than integer because guess_points may contain fractional values.

blue_attempts_used.description: How many guesses team Blue has used on the current artwork (0..max_attempts).

yellow_attempts_used.description: How many guesses team Yellow has used on the current artwork (0..max_attempts).

blue_guessed_correctly.description: True if team Blue has already made a correct guess this round. Resets to false at each round boundary. Public across agents so the visualizer can distinguish a correct final guess from a wrong one before the round rolls into history (the visualizer would otherwise have to reimplement _matches_target's singular/plural leniency in TypeScript to reproduce this signal).

yellow_guessed_correctly.description: True if team Yellow has already made a correct guess this round. Resets to false at each round boundary. Public across agents so the visualizer can distinguish a correct final guess from a wrong one before the round rolls into history.

blue_art_disqualified.description: True if team Blue's art this round was disqualified by the engine (target-word check or any-word check). Public across agents; set at guess-phase entry and cleared at each round boundary.

yellow_art_disqualified.description: True if team Yellow's art this round was disqualified by the engine. Public across agents; set at guess-phase entry and cleared at each round boundary.

blue_art_disqualification_reason.description: Reason team Blue's art was disqualified ('target_word' or 'contains_words'), or null when the art passed. Public across agents; set at guess-phase entry and cleared at each round boundary.

yellow_art_disqualification_reason.description: Reason team Yellow's art was disqualified ('target_word' or 'contains_words'), or null when the art passed. Public across agents; set at guess-phase entry and cleared at each round boundary.

history.description: List of completed rounds, each {word, blue_art, blue_art_disqualified, blue_guesses (list), blue_points, yellow_art, yellow_art_disqualified, yellow_guesses (list), yellow_points}. blue_art / yellow_art are the artist's raw submission (preserved for replay transparency even when the env disqualified it).

action.description: Artist phase: a string containing ASCII art of the target word. Guess phase: a string with the guessed word (matched case-insensitively after trimming; singular/plural equivalents accepted -- CAT and CATS, CHILD and CHILDREN both match). May also be a dict with key 'submission' wrapping the string, or null (counts as empty submission).

reward.description: Cumulative points scored by this agent's team. Each round contributes 0 (no correct guess) or the value of guess_points[attempt_index] on a correct guess. May be fractional when guess_points contains non-integer values.
